This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior .Net Full Stack Software Engineer based in Romania.
 We are looking for an experienced Senior .Net Full Stack Software Engineer to contribute to the development of an innovative online learning platform designed to make education more engaging, accessible, and inclusive. In this role, you will build and maintain scalable web applications using modern backend and frontend technologies, helping deliver personalized digital learning experiences to students. You will collaborate with product managers, engineering leaders, and cross-functional teams to design and implement impactful features that enhance the user experience. Beyond hands-on development, you will contribute to technical excellence by promoting clean architecture, maintainable code, and software engineering best practices. You will also mentor junior developers and support a collaborative culture focused on continuous improvement. This is an exciting opportunity to work on a meaningful educational technology project within a diverse, experienced, and flexible international engineering environment.
 Accountabilities
Design, develop, implement, and maintain scalable, reliable, and high-performance web applications using C#/.NET and Vue.js.
Build and enhance full-stack solutions that support personalized, interactive, and accessible online learning experiences.
Collaborate with product managers, engineering managers, business stakeholders, and other development teams to identify requirements, define priorities, and deliver valuable product features.
Translate technical and business requirements into effective software solutions while ensuring high standards of performance, scalability, and maintainability.
Write clean, efficient, reusable, and testable code in accordance with established software engineering principles and best practices.
Apply clean architecture principles to improve application flexibility, extensibility, reliability, and long-term maintainability.
Participate in code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and promote consistent development standards across the engineering team.
Mentor and support junior developers, sharing technical knowledge and helping them improve their coding practices and problem-solving abilities.
Contribute to architectural discussions and technical decisions to continuously improve application quality and development processes.
Work closely with multidisciplinary and distributed teams to ensure successful delivery of features and alignment with project objectives.
Take ownership of assigned development tasks, manage priorities effectively, and ensure timely delivery of high-quality software.
 Requirements 
At least 6 years of professional experience in software development, with a strong background in full-stack engineering.
At least 2 years of hands-on experience with each of the following technologies, with senior-level expertise in at least one:
Modern C# and .NET development.
Vue.js or comparable reactive frontend frameworks such as React or Angular.
CSS and modern frontend styling practices.
Relational or other database technologies.
Strong understanding of clean coding principles and software engineering best practices, including maintainability, flexibility, extensibility, and reliability.
Experience designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications across backend and frontend environments.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in distributed and remote teams.
Experience participating in code reviews, providing constructive feedback, and receiving technical feedback from colleagues.
Familiarity with version control systems and collaborative software development workflows.
Previous experience mentoring other developers, either formally or informally.
Ability to work independently, organize priorities, manage schedules, and consistently meet project deadlines.
A growth-oriented mindset, openness to constructive feedback, and enthusiasm for continuous learning and technical improvement.
A genuine interest in education technology and motivation to develop digital solutions that positively impact students and educators.
A university degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline is an advantage.
Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Google Cloud Storage (GCS), or similar cloud technologies is desirable.
Familiarity with PostgreSQL and modern database management practices is a plus.
Knowledge of DevOps practices and tools, including CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes, Helm, Argo CD, and Terraform, is an advantage.
Experience in application security, SecOps, cloud security, or related areas is beneficial.
Understanding of application migration patterns, such as strangler-fig, dual-write, and Change Data Capture (CDC), is a plus.
Familiarity with software rollout strategies, including blue-green deployments, canary releases, and phased rollouts, is desirable.
 Benefits
Flexible working arrangements: Choose between remote, office-based, or hybrid working options, depending on location and project requirements.
Competitive compensation: Attractive salary and comprehensive compensation package.
Career development: Personalized career growth opportunities aligned with your professional goals and technical interests.
Professional learning: Access to mentorship programs, technical talks, training sessions, and internal Centers of Excellence.
Knowledge sharing: Participation in active technical communities and regular opportunities to exchange expertise with fellow engineers.
Education support: Financial reimbursement for eligible professional education and learning activities.
Recognition: Memorable anniversary gifts and employee appreciation initiatives.
Team culture: Corporate events, team-building activities, and opportunities to connect with colleagues.
Additional perks: Other location-specific benefits depending on the employment arrangement.
Meaningful projects: Opportunity to contribute to an educational technology platform focused on making quality learning experiences accessible to students from diverse backgrounds.
